projects.title: Text Summarizer
projects.description: A sophisticated text summarization tool powered by AI that condenses lengthy articles and documents into concise summaries while maintaining key information and context.
projects.longDescription: This project utilizes advanced NLP techniques and machine learning algorithms to generate accurate and coherent summaries. Built with Python and Flask, it provides a web interface where users can paste text and receive instant summaries at various compression levels.
features: AI-powered text summarization with adjustable compression
Support for multiple text formats and lengths

projects.title: Job Application Tracker
projects.description: A Python terminal program with a user-friendly interface to help users keep track of their job applications with full CRUD operations.
projects.longDescription: Built with Python's inquirer package, this tool creates an interactive terminal interface for managing job applications. Users can add, view, update, and delete applications while storing details such as company name, position, application date, status, and notes. Data is persisted in a SQLite database for easy retrieval.
features: Full CRUD operations for job applications
Track status, notes, and application dates

projects.title: School History Website
projects.description: A minimalistic website documenting school history, built as part of an Extended Project Qualification (EPQ) achieving an A* grade.
projects.longDescription: This website was created using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as part of my Extended Project Qualification in Year 12. It documents the history of my school through research and development, resulting in a clean, informative web experience hosted on GitHub Pages.
features: Historical research presented in an engaging format

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring a cyberpunk design theme with smooth animations.
projects.longDescription: This very website! A complete rebuild from a Jekyll-based portfolio to a modern React + Vite application with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, and Framer Motion animations. Features a cyberpunk-inspired design with neon accents, glassmorphism effects, and a fully static architecture deployed to GitHub Pages.
features: Smooth page transitions and scroll animations
Fully static, deployed to GitHub Pages
